run_explorer: run the explorer function to launch SLURM jobs for training models on varying numbers of subjects
run_clip_explorer: run the ClipExplorer decorated function to launch grid experiments with WER and WER vocab metrics
run_slurm_jobs: run SLURM jobs with 2 GPUs and 200 MB per GPU on the learnlab partition
run_job_array: run a job array that iterates over seeds and audio datasets with varying subject counts
run_bind_config: run launcher bind to configure model as clip_conv with batch size 256 and dataset selections
